visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a woman's hands using silver scissors to cut through thick yellow packing tape on a brown cardboard box placed on a light-colored wooden floor. She is wearing a brown long-sleeved shirt and a light green blanket with cartoon patterns draped over her lap. (2) As she continues cutting, the camera angle widens to show her seated on the floor in front of a light gray sofa. She successfully opens the flaps of the box, revealing a smaller, black cardboard box inside wrapped in bubble wrap. (3) She lifts the black box, which features a golden illustration of the character Stitch and the Disney logo. She removes the outer sleeve and opens the black box, pulling out a white styrofoam container. (4) The woman carefully unboxes a black and gold Stitch figurine, which is holding a golden staff with a snake head. She turns the figurine around to show its front and back details, including gold-painted eyes and intricate patterns. (5) Finally, she opens a glass-fronted display cabinet filled with numerous other figurines and collectibles. She places the new Stitch figurine inside, alongside a white and gold Dragon Year version and other limited-edition character toys, showcasing the complete collection.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the sharp, rhythmic sound of scissors cutting through plastic tape. A woman's voice is heard speaking in an excited, high-pitched Mandarin, accompanied by a light, acoustic guitar-driven upbeat BGM. (2) As the box is opened, a loud rustling of paper and plastic occurs. The woman laughs gently as she interacts with her partner, whose deeper male voice responds with a playful, joking tone. (3) A distinct 'ding' sound effect plays when a logo is highlighted. The woman's voice becomes more enunciated as she reads the limited-edition details. The BGM remains consistent in tempo and volume. (4) Sound of styrofoam sliding against cardboard creates a high-frequency squeak. The couple's conversation is continuous and fast-paced, filled with positive exclamations about the figurine's appearance. (5) The audio concludes with the metallic click and sliding sound of glass cabinet doors. The male voice expresses awe at the full collection, with a final playful pop sound effect as the video ends.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves to showcase the unboxing and presentation of a limited-edition Disney Stitch figurine (Snake Year version). It aims to share the excitement of the unboxing experience, highlight the product's high-quality design, and display the creator's extensive collection of similar toys to engage a community of collectors and Disney fans.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: While the video features Disney products, it is presented as a personal unboxing and gift-sharing vlog rather than a paid advertisement.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video features high editing density with frequent text overlays and sound effects typical of social media vlogs. The lighting is bright and the audio is very clear.
